name: decomposition-reframe-reconciliation
body: The goal is well-decomposed, DRY, modular, maintainable source; line count is a signal rather than a target. `requirements.requirement.decomposed-source-modules` (feature `source-decomposition`) and `global.constraint.decomposition-quality` carry the goal, and `domain.value.module-size-signal` states the ~400-line figure as indicative. The law covers repo-wide first-party source and excludes vendored code (`src/cpplib/vendor/**`) and testdata (`testdata/**`) — the root Rust crate (`src/*.rs` plus `build.rs`) and the eight frontend crates. `domain.group.source-layout` and `domain.entity.source-module` are `realised-by` each of the eight frontend containers, and each container is `implemented-by` its crate's code root. `domain.entity.source-file` is prior work (`realised-by` `solution.component.identity-layer`), and `requirements.requirement.decomposed-source-modules` leaves it to the requirements `portable-graph-identity` and `repo-relative-file-identity`. The eight frontend code roots are `rust.structfrontend`, `rust.pyfrontend`, `rust.apg-rustfrontend`, `cpp.cpplib`, `java.(default)`, `go.apg/gofrontend`, `csharp.Apg.CsharpFrontend`, and `ts.apg-tsfrontend`. `cpp.cpplib` covers `src/cpplib/main.cpp` and its vendored tree-sitter headers alike; the law's scope excludes `src/cpplib/vendor/**` at the file level. `java.(default)` is the Java frontend's default-package module. `Cargo.toml`, `.cargo/config.toml`, `scripts/gate.sh`, and `rust-toolchain.toml` are graphed `File` nodes (`code_type = 'config'`), so they serve as task and `implemented-by` targets. The lib/bin rooting decision for `src/lib.rs` alongside `src/main.rs` remains open.
